svg.text: FRCS Part 1 (General Surgery) · NICE NG49 / NG50 · Baveno VII · MASLD · alcohol · viral · non-invasive fibrosis · HPB (2 of 2 · sheet 1)
2023: SLD is the umbrella; MASH replaces NASH;
Weight loss ≥7–10%; treat metabolic risk; no
A & E faeco-oral (acute); B, C, D blood-borne
HBsAg+; tenofovir or entecavir; HCC risk even
Vaccinate A & B; HCC surveillance if cirrhotic or
Maddrey discriminant function ≥32 = severe (also GAHS, MELD). Exclude sepsis & GI bleed first
Prednisolone 40 mg/day for 28 days in severe disease
Prednisolone gave no significant 28-day mortality benefit (trend only) and none at 90 d / 1 y, with more serious infection;
Lille score at day 7 >0.45 = steroid non-responder → stop
HBsAg+; tenofovir or entecavir; HCC risk even without cirrhosis; vaccine
Self-limiting; chronic if immunosuppressed; severe in pregnancy
cACLD — WHO CAN SKIP SCREENING ENDOSCOPY?
Very low (<5%) risk of high-risk varices
No screening endoscopy; repeat LSM + platelets yearly
LSM ≥25 kPa → carvedilol to prevent decompensation;
MASLD is a positive diagnosis — hepatic steatosis plus at least one cardiometabolic criterion, not merely the exclusion of alcohol.
Use FIB-4 first; an ELF score ≥10.51 indicates advanced fibrosis (NICE NG49) and should trigger transient elastography and specialist referral.
In severe alcoholic hepatitis (Maddrey DF ≥32) prednisolone offers at best a small short-term benefit (STOPAH) — reassess with the Lille score
at day 7 and stop if >0.45. Pentoxifylline is not recommended.
Transient elastography <20 kPa with platelets >150 ×10⁹/L safely spares screening endoscopy (Baveno); LSM ≥25 kPa signals clinically
Offer transient elastography to diagnose cirrhosis in heavy drinkers (>50 units/week men, >35 women) and in NAFLD with advanced fibrosis
Hepatitis B can cause HCC without cirrhosis — surveillance is not restricted to cirrhotic patients.
Sources: NICE NG49 (non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, 2016) · NICE NG50 (cirrhosis in over-16s, 2016) · Baveno VII consensus on portal hypertension (J Hepatol 2022) · AASLD/EASL/ALEH
steatotic liver disease nomenclature (2023). Non-invasive fibrosis: FIB-4, Enhanced Liver Fibrosis (ELF), vibration-controlled transient elastography (FibroScan).
Trial: STOPAH (Thursz et al., NEJM 2015) — prednisolone vs pentoxifylline in severe alcoholic hepatitis. Cirrhosis, scoring and decompensation are on the companion sheet (2 of 2).
Revision aid — verify against current local guidance before clinical use.
